instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Music rights and publishing company managing a catalog of 5,000 songs across 200 songwriters and composers. Handling royalty collection, sync licensing for TV/film/advertising, and copyright enforcement. The industry is heavily regulated by international performance rights organizations (PROs) and complex anti-piracy laws, requiring meticulous compliance to maintain operational integrity.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.additionalContext: We are planning an IPO within 24 months and need to demonstrate a track record of innovation-driven growth to public market investors. The CFO has asked for a 3-year innovation investment plan with clear KPIs that can be included in our equity story and analyst presentations. Bonus points for initiatives that improve our ESG metrics, as this is a key focus area for the listing venue.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: Automated Royalty Tracking and Infringement Monitoring System
opportunities.rationale: Implementing AI-assisted music similarity detection directly addresses the company's stated need for automated tracking from streaming platforms. This provides immediate operational efficiency, reduces manual errors in royalty calculation, and strengthens market defense by minimizing intellectual property risk.

first_actions: Conduct a vendor RFP for music rights management (MRM) software.
Pilot AI similarity detection on 10% of the catalog.
Secure legal approval for integrating automated monitoring tools.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in royalty calculation error rate by 40% within Q3.
milestones: Q1: Vendor selection and contract negotiation complete.
Q2: Pilot program of similarity detection launched successfully.
Q3: Full system integration for core royalty reporting.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Music Experience Engine (AI/ML)
opportunities.rationale: To combat customer churn, we must move beyond self-service tools into proactive engagement. A radical personalized engine using generative AI to recommend highly specific, rights-cleared music segments tailored to individual enterprise client needs could redefine the value proposition and drive significant retention.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated task force focused purely on UX/AI integration for customer portals.
Identify key pain points from exit interviews for feature prioritization.
Run proof-of-concept using existing data to model personalized recommendations.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in enterprise customer retention rate by 5 points within 2 years.
milestones: Q3: Define technical specifications and data requirements for the engine.
Q1 of next year: Launch MVP tailored to mid-tier clients.
End of Year 2: Full feature rollout integrated into self-service platform.

next_steps.action: Finalize the RFP and vendor selection for the automated royalty tracking system.
Conduct a deep-dive analysis of customer churn data to identify three critical digital self-service gaps that require radical redesign.
Develop the preliminary 3-year investment roadmap, prioritizing regulatory compliance automation and retention technology pilots for executive review.

key_weaknesses: High operational reliance on manual workflows and spreadsheets in non-core areas, leading to inefficiency.
Limited talent pool specialized in the intersection of high-level copyright law and advanced data science (AI).
Partial innovation process: Lack of standardized framework for scaling successful pilot projects across the organization.
